chunks: 1 - He said: The noble and righteous al-Sharif Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza al-Alawi, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Abdullah, who said: My grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us, from his father, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umair, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Ubayda al-Hadhdha, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), who said: He said:

Should I not inform you of the most stringent obligations Allah has imposed upon His creatures? Being fair and just with people in their own affairs, consoling brothers for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and remembering Allah in every situation. If an act of obedience to Allah presents itself to him, he performs it; and if a sin presents itself to him, he avoids it.

key_terms.إنصاف: Insaf - Fairness, equity, doing justice to others from one's own self
key_terms.افترض: Iftarada - Made obligatory, prescribed as a religious duty
key_terms.ذكر الله: Dhikr Allah - Remembrance of God, being mindful of God in every situation
key_terms.مواساة: Muwasah - Consolation, mutual support and comforting of brothers in faith

ai.seo_question: What are the three most important obligations Allah has placed on His creatures according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches three of the most important obligations God has placed upon humanity: (1) being fair and just with others as one would wish for oneself, (2) consoling and supporting fellow believers for the sake of God, and (3) constant remembrance of God in all circumstances, acting on obedience and avoiding disobedience. This teaching was delivered in the context of Imam al-Sadiq's circle of companions, emphasizing the inseparability of social justice, brotherly solidarity, and spiritual mindfulness in Islamic ethics.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Al-Shareef al-Swaleh Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza al-Alawi, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Yaqoob ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umair, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Ubaidah al-Hazzá, that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said:

"Should I not guide you to the most important obligations Allah has placed upon His creatures? To be fair and just with people in their dealings; to be comforting to the brothers in faith; to remember Allah in every situation. And when he faces a matter of obedience to Allah, he acts accordingly and when he comes across any sin, he shuns it."
